description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages used in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset, with each slice representing a specific language and its corresponding proportion of the total. The largest segment, colored dark blue, represents English, which accounts for 5.8% of the dataset. The second largest segment, in medium blue, corresponds to Spanish, making up 31.4% of the data. The remaining languages are grouped into smaller slices: Russian (5.7%), German (3.6%), French (2.9%), Chinese (2.5%), Thai (1.9%), Portuguese (Brazil) (1.7%), and Catalan (1.6%). These smaller segments are arranged in descending order of percentage from right to left, with the "Other" category, representing all remaining languages, shown as a light gray slice at the top, contributing 5.8% to the total. The chart includes labels for each language and its percentage value, with the "Other" category positioned at the top of the pie.
